column7: requireReauth checked only the caller's snapshot of the lockout and never re-read it after the code or password matched, unlike login, MFA verify, step-up and WebAuthn, so a correct guess racing a lock-out burst passed and cleared the counter. It now calls recheckLockAfterCredentialMatched before clearLoginFailures; a locked or failed re-check answers like a wrong code. Remaining half of #2888, found by ISSUE-AUDIT triage 2026-11-20
